text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Thanks! New Year's in Japan is awful fun!
choice_data_list: 明けましておめでとう！

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I've had me some of those New Year's
dishes...
Freshly pounded mochi, mochi
soup—the works! It
was all delicious!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But that doesn't mean I'm done whoopin'
it up. I
wanna do more!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Say, Trainer! Know any other fun things I
could
do?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, good idea! Grass was just sayin' that
too!
choice_data_list_en: How about setting a New Year's resolution?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Well, I know I wanna be the next
Umamusume of
the Year...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
What do you wanna do, Trainer?
Become a
millionaire?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! You're tellin' me we can make
both our
dreams come true at the same
time?!
choice_data_list_en: I'll make sure you seize your dream.
I'll make sure you seize your dream.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
What can I say—our hearts are beatin' as
one!
Okay, let's work together to make
it happen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With our resolutions decided, next is to
figure out
the steps to get there...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Well... If I had to get specific...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, but thinkin' ain't my strong suit!
You're
gonna have to take this one,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't expecting to be thrown in the
deep end.
If we're going to make Taiki
Shuttle the next
Umamusume of the
Year...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Increasin' my speed? Oh, I know a thing
or two
about that! Call it my specialty!
choice_data_list: スピードを伸ばしていこう
休む時はしっかり休もう
武器をどんどん鍛えよう
choice_data_list_en: Let's work on increasing your speed.
When it's time to rest, make sure to rest properly.
Let's keep honing that weapon of yours.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness... I dunno what I
would've done if
you'd said studying.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
N-not that I'm bad at studyin' or nothin',
mind
you! Honest!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vaguely worried about just how poor she
must be
at studying, I talk her through
my ideas for
brushing up her speed.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer, just how much do ya know?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I was plannin' on rounding up all my
friends for
some non-stop partyin' this
New Year's break...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But all right... I'll get some rest. That's
what I
gotta do to become Umamusume
of the Year.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
...But do ya think I could throw one
teensy little
party? Just for a single day?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not wanting anything to impact our
training, I
warn her to keep her partying
within reason.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Arsenal? Ya mean weapons?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: So it's a quick draw ya want! Bang, bang!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I can also throw a mean lasso! Not to
mention...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I clarify that I'm not talking about actual

weapons, but rather the importance of
improving
her skills.
